example.zh: 她看完信，眼里含着泪，半天说不出话来。
example.en: After reading the letter, she had tears in her eyes and couldn't speak for a long while.

quiz.zh: 这部电影太感人了，我看到最后忍不住流泪了。
quiz.en: This film was so moving that I couldn't help crying at the end.

example.zh: 这批货物明天上午就能运到仓库。
example.en: This batch of goods will reach the warehouse tomorrow morning.

quiz.zh: 这条铁路每年要运送大量煤炭和其他货物。
quiz.en: This railway carries large amounts of coal and other goods every year.

example.zh: 老年人是一个需要社会更多关心的群体。
example.en: The elderly are a group that needs more care from society.

quiz.zh: 这款游戏在大学生群体中特别受欢迎。
quiz.en: This game is especially popular among university students.

example.zh: 请在本周五之前把论文提交给导师。
example.en: Please submit your thesis to your supervisor by this Friday.

quiz.zh: 填好申请表以后，点击页面下方的按钮就可以在线提交了。
quiz.en: Once you've filled in the application form, click the button at the bottom of the page to submit it online.

共享.gloss: to share (use or enjoy in common)

example.zh: 这几个部门共享一台打印机，用的时候得排队。
example.en: These departments share one printer, so you have to wait your turn to use it.

quiz.zh: 现在很多城市都能看到共享单车，扫码就能骑走。
quiz.en: You can see shared bikes in many cities now; just scan the code and ride off.

example.zh: 做生意最重要的是讲信用，不能欺骗顾客。
example.en: The most important thing in business is to keep your word; you must never cheat customers.

quiz.zh: 他好几次借钱不还，在朋友中早就没有信用了。
quiz.en: He has borrowed money and not paid it back several times, so his friends stopped trusting him long ago.

example.zh: 他在城里工作了十年，最后还是决定回乡种地。
example.en: After ten years working in the city, he finally decided to go back to his village and farm.

quiz.zh: 这个乡一共有十二个村，人口不到两万。
quiz.en: This township has twelve villages and a population of under twenty thousand.

example.zh: 今晚天上一片云都没有，星星看得特别清楚。
example.en: There isn't a single cloud in the sky tonight, so the stars are especially clear.

quiz.zh: 孩子指着天上的飞机，兴奋地喊了起来。
quiz.en: The child pointed at the plane in the sky and shouted excitedly.

存款.gloss: to deposit money; savings, bank deposit

example.zh: 他每个月都会去银行存款，准备以后买房。
example.en: He goes to the bank every month to deposit money, saving up to buy a home.

quiz.zh: 工作五年后，她终于有了一笔不小的存款。
quiz.en: After five years of work, she finally had a sizeable amount of savings.

example.zh: 这只是一个短期项目，大概三个月就能完成。
example.en: This is just a short-term project; it should be done in about three months.

quiz.zh: 暑假我打算报一个短期英语培训班。
quiz.en: I'm planning to sign up for a short English course over the summer holiday.

example.zh: 这条河最深的地方，深度超过十米。
example.en: At its deepest point, this river is more than ten metres deep.

quiz.zh: 这篇报道很有深度，把问题分析得很透彻。
quiz.en: This report has real depth; it analyses the problem thoroughly.

停留.gloss: to stay (for a while); to stop over

example.zh: 我们在上海只停留两天，然后就去杭州。
example.en: We're only staying in Shanghai for two days, then going on to Hangzhou.

quiz.zh: 飞机在香港短暂停留一小时后，继续飞往悉尼。
quiz.en: After a one-hour stopover in Hong Kong, the plane flew on to Sydney.

example.zh: 文章太长了，编辑让我删掉一半内容。
example.en: The article is too long; the editor told me to cut half of it.

quiz.zh: 照片发错群了，他赶紧把它删掉了。
quiz.en: He posted the photo in the wrong group chat, so he quickly deleted it.

example.zh: 本次活动的具体安排如下，请大家仔细阅读。
example.en: The detailed arrangements for this event are as follows; please read them carefully.

quiz.zh: 报名需要准备的材料如下：身份证、照片和成绩单。
quiz.en: The documents needed for registration are as follows: ID card, photos and transcript.

example.zh: 我小时候是外婆带大的，所以跟她特别亲。
example.en: I was raised by my grandma when I was little, so I'm especially close to her.

quiz.zh: 每年暑假，妈妈都带我回老家看外婆和外公。
quiz.en: Every summer holiday, Mum takes me back to her hometown to see Grandma and Grandpa.

example.zh: 他从小的梦想就是当一名飞行员，开飞机上天。
example.en: His childhood dream was to become a pilot and fly planes.

quiz.zh: 由于飞行员处理得当，飞机安全降落在附近的机场。
quiz.en: Thanks to the pilot's skilful handling, the plane landed safely at a nearby airport.

大力.indonesian: tenaga besar; dengan gencar, sekuat tenaga

example.zh: 政府正在大力发展新能源汽车。
example.en: The government is vigorously developing new-energy vehicles.

quiz.zh: 这几年学校大力支持学生参加各种社会实践活动。
quiz.en: In recent years the school has strongly supported students taking part in all kinds of social activities.

长久.indonesian: tahan lama; untuk waktu yang lama

example.zh: 靠骗人赚钱的生意是不会长久的。
example.en: A business that makes money by cheating people won't last long.

quiz.zh: 两个人相处，只有互相尊重，感情才能长久。
quiz.en: In a relationship, love can only last if both people respect each other.

中华民族.gloss: the Chinese nation; the Chinese people

example.zh: 春节是中华民族最重要的传统节日。
example.en: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival of the Chinese nation.

quiz.zh: 长城是中华民族的象征之一，每年吸引无数游客。
quiz.en: The Great Wall is one of the symbols of the Chinese nation and attracts countless tourists every year.

example.zh: 这两个国家在经济上的联系非常紧密。
example.en: The economic ties between these two countries are very close.

quiz.zh: 学习和生活是紧密相连的，不能分开来看。
quiz.en: Study and life are closely linked and can't be looked at separately.

example.zh: 爬了一上午的山，大家的体力都快用完了。
example.en: After climbing the mountain all morning, everyone was nearly out of energy.

quiz.zh: 搬家是个体力活，你最好多叫几个朋友来帮忙。
quiz.en: Moving house is hard physical work; you'd better get a few more friends to help.

视为.gloss: to regard as; to treat as

example.zh: 在中国，红色被视为吉祥的颜色。
example.en: In China, red is regarded as a lucky colour.

quiz.zh: 考试中使用手机的，一律视为作弊。
quiz.en: Anyone using a mobile phone during the exam will be treated as cheating.

example.zh: 李白是中国历史上最有名的诗人之一。
example.en: Li Bai is one of the most famous poets in Chinese history.

quiz.zh: 这位年轻诗人的第一本诗集一出版就卖光了。
quiz.en: This young poet's first collection of poems sold out as soon as it came out.

打断.gloss: to interrupt; to cut off (someone speaking)

example.zh: 别人说话的时候，随便打断是很不礼貌的。
example.en: It's very rude to interrupt when someone else is talking.

quiz.zh: 他刚开口要解释，就被经理不耐烦地打断了。
quiz.en: He had barely started to explain when the manager impatiently cut him off.

example.zh: 学汉语的时候，语音和声调一定要打好基础。
example.en: When learning Chinese, you must build a solid foundation in pronunciation and tones.

quiz.zh: 他开车不方便打字，就给我发了一条语音。
quiz.en: He was driving and couldn't type, so he sent me a voice message.

example.zh: 为了不影响居民休息，这里禁止夜间施工。
example.en: To avoid disturbing residents, construction is banned here at night.

quiz.zh: 这家医院的急诊科夜间也有医生值班。
quiz.en: This hospital's emergency department has doctors on duty at night as well.

有助于.gloss: to help; to be conducive to, to contribute to

example.zh: 每天坚持运动有助于提高睡眠质量。
example.en: Exercising every day helps improve the quality of your sleep.

quiz.zh: 多读课外书有助于扩大孩子的知识面。
quiz.en: Reading more books outside of class helps broaden children's knowledge.

用力.gloss: to use one's strength; to exert oneself

example.zh: 瓶盖太紧了，我用力拧了半天才打开。
example.en: The bottle cap was really tight; I had to twist hard for ages to get it open.

quiz.zh: 他用力推了一下门，门却一动也不动。
quiz.en: He pushed the door hard, but it didn't budge at all.

拨打.gloss: to dial (a phone number); to call

example.zh: 如果遇到火灾，请立即拨打119报警。
example.en: If there's a fire, call 119 immediately.

quiz.zh: 您拨打的电话暂时无人接听，请稍后再拨。
quiz.en: The number you have dialled is not answering; please try again later.

example.zh: 这次旅行的行程安排得太满了，大家都很累。
example.en: The itinerary for this trip was too packed, and everyone was exhausted.

quiz.zh: 因为台风，我们不得不改变行程，提前回国。
quiz.en: Because of the typhoon, we had to change our travel plans and go home early.

example.zh: 护士每隔两个小时就到病房查看一次。
example.en: The nurse comes to check on the ward every two hours.

quiz.zh: 他住的病房里一共有三张病床，另外两张也都住了人。
quiz.en: The ward he's in has three beds, and the other two are occupied as well.

example.zh: 这家公司每年都投入大量资金研发新产品。
example.en: This company invests heavily in developing new products every year.

quiz.zh: 他大学毕业后进了一家互联网公司，负责软件研发。
quiz.en: After graduating, he joined an internet company and works in software development.

example.zh: 参加面试的时候，他特意穿了一套西装。
example.en: He made a point of wearing a suit to the job interview.

quiz.zh: 这套西装是在店里量身定做的，穿起来非常合身。
quiz.en: This suit was tailor-made at the shop and fits perfectly.

example.zh: 今天天空是灰色的，看样子快要下雨了。
example.en: The sky is grey today; it looks like it's about to rain.

quiz.zh: 他买了一件灰色的大衣，跟什么裤子都好搭配。
quiz.en: He bought a grey coat that goes with any pair of trousers.

销量.gloss: sales volume; number of units sold

example.zh: 这款手机上个月的销量突破了一百万台。
example.en: Sales of this phone passed one million units last month.

quiz.zh: 因为天气太冷，冰淇淋的销量明显下降了。
quiz.en: Because the weather is so cold, ice cream sales have dropped noticeably.

example.zh: 图书馆的书都是按照内容分类摆放的。
example.en: The library's books are shelved by subject.

quiz.zh: 我们小区要求居民把垃圾分类以后再扔。
quiz.en: Our neighbourhood requires residents to sort their rubbish before throwing it out.

example.zh: 这座大楼的外部正在重新装修。
example.en: The outside of this building is being renovated.

quiz.zh: 公司遇到的困难主要来自外部，比如市场竞争越来越激烈。
quiz.en: The company's difficulties come mainly from outside, such as ever fiercer market competition.

名称.gloss: name (of a thing or organization); designation

example.zh: 请在表格里填上公司的名称和地址。
example.en: Please fill in the company's name and address on the form.

quiz.zh: 这种植物在不同地方有不同的名称，很容易弄混。
quiz.en: This plant has different names in different places, so it's easy to mix up.

向上.gloss: upward; to go up; to strive upward

example.zh: 电梯正在向上运行，请稍等一下。
example.en: The lift is going up; please wait a moment.

quiz.zh: 他是一个积极向上的年轻人，从来不怕困难。
quiz.en: He's a positive, driven young man who's never afraid of difficulties.

预约.gloss: to make an appointment; to book in advance

example.zh: 这家医院看病需要提前在网上预约。
example.en: To see a doctor at this hospital, you need to book online in advance.

quiz.zh: 博物馆每天限流三千人，参观前必须预约。
quiz.en: The museum admits only 3,000 visitors a day, so you must book before you go.

更换.gloss: to replace; to change (for a new one)

example.zh: 手机电池已经用了三年，该更换了。
example.en: The phone battery has been in use for three years; it's time to replace it.

quiz.zh: 这套系统已经很旧了，公司打算明年全部更换。
quiz.en: This system is very old; the company plans to replace all of it next year.

example.zh: 他在地铁上丢失了钱包，赶紧去报了警。
example.en: He lost his wallet on the subway and quickly reported it to the police.

quiz.zh: 如果银行卡丢失，请马上打电话办理挂失。
quiz.en: If your bank card goes missing, call right away to report it lost.

近期.gloss: the near future; the recent period

example.zh: 近期天气变化大，大家要注意别感冒。
example.en: The weather has been changeable lately, so be careful not to catch a cold.

quiz.zh: 该公司表示近期不会再推出新产品。
quiz.en: The company said it won't launch any new products in the near future.

评.gloss: to judge; to evaluate; to comment on

example.zh: 老师让同学们互相评一评作文写得怎么样。
example.en: The teacher had the students assess each other's essays.

quiz.zh: 他工作非常努力，今年被评为公司的优秀员工。
quiz.en: He works very hard and was named one of the company's outstanding employees this year.

example.zh: 大雪天路很滑，车辆都在缓慢行驶。
example.en: The roads are slippery in the heavy snow, and cars are moving slowly.

quiz.zh: 受全球市场影响，今年的经济增长速度十分缓慢。
quiz.en: Affected by the global market, economic growth this year has been very slow.

行走.gloss: to walk; to go on foot

example.zh: 手术以后，他已经可以慢慢下地行走了。
example.en: Since the operation, he's been able to get out of bed and walk slowly.

quiz.zh: 这位盲人靠着导盲犬，能够在城市里独立行走。
quiz.en: With the help of his guide dog, this blind man can get around the city on his own.

出自.gloss: to come from; to originate from (a source)

example.zh: 这句名言出自《论语》，很多人都会背。
example.en: This famous saying comes from the Analects, and many people know it by heart.

quiz.zh: 这幅画一看就出自名家之手，价格肯定不便宜。
quiz.en: You can tell at a glance this painting is by a master, so it certainly won't be cheap.

example.zh: 他每天都是第一个到公司，由此可见他工作有多认真。
example.en: He's the first to arrive at the office every day, which shows how seriously he takes his work.

quiz.zh: 两国领导人成功会谈，两国关系由此进入了新阶段。
quiz.en: The two leaders held successful talks, and relations between the two countries thus entered a new stage.

example.zh: 这套房子的租金是每个月三千块。
example.en: The rent for this flat is three thousand yuan a month.

quiz.zh: 市中心的店面租金太高，他只好把店搬到了郊区。
quiz.en: Shop rents in the city centre were too high, so he had to move his shop to the suburbs.

example.zh: 这次考试虽然有几道题很难，但总体来说不算太难。
example.en: There were a few hard questions in this exam, but overall it wasn't too difficult.

quiz.zh: 今年公司的总体情况比去年好很多。
quiz.en: The company's overall situation this year is much better than last year.

应对.gloss: to deal with; to cope with; to respond to

example.zh: 面对突发情况，他总能冷静地应对。
example.en: When something unexpected happens, he always handles it calmly.

quiz.zh: 各国应当共同努力，应对气候变化带来的挑战。
quiz.en: All countries should work together to meet the challenges of climate change.

example.zh: 这个房间光线太暗，不适合看书。
example.en: The light in this room is too dim for reading.

quiz.zh: 拍照的时候要注意光线，逆光拍出来的脸会很黑。
quiz.en: Pay attention to the light when taking photos; faces come out dark against the light.

example.zh: 最近的工作强度太大，他每天都加班到深夜。
example.en: His workload has been so intense lately that he works overtime until late every night.

quiz.zh: 医生建议他刚开始锻炼时，不要把运动强度定得太高。
quiz.en: The doctor advised him not to set the intensity of his workouts too high when he first starts.

example.zh: 为了保护环境，很多餐厅已经不提供一次性筷子了。
example.en: To protect the environment, many restaurants no longer provide disposable chopsticks.

quiz.zh: 这笔钱可以一次性付清，也可以分十二个月还。
quiz.en: You can pay this sum in full at once or pay it back over twelve months.

变动.gloss: to change; to fluctuate; change, alteration

example.zh: 由于天气原因，航班时间可能会有变动。
example.en: Due to the weather, flight times may change.

quiz.zh: 公司人事发生了较大变动，好几位经理都换了人。
quiz.en: There has been a major staff reshuffle at the company, with several managers replaced.

example.zh: 周末我们去河边烧烤吧，我负责带肉。
example.en: Let's have a barbecue by the river this weekend; I'll bring the meat.

quiz.zh: 夏天的晚上，街边的烧烤摊总是坐满了人。
quiz.en: On summer evenings, the roadside barbecue stalls are always packed.

example.zh: 这种新型材料又轻又结实，很适合造飞机。
example.en: This new type of material is light and strong, ideal for building aircraft.

quiz.zh: 警方提醒市民，要警惕各种新型网络诈骗。
quiz.en: The police are warning the public to watch out for new kinds of online fraud.

example.zh: 这位老师上课时很注意和学生互动。
example.en: This teacher makes a point of interacting with students in class.

quiz.zh: 演唱会上，歌手不时走下舞台和观众互动。
quiz.en: At the concert, the singer kept stepping off the stage to interact with the audience.

example.zh: 比赛还没开始，赛场上已经坐满了观众。
example.en: The match hadn't started yet, but the arena was already full of spectators.

quiz.zh: 受伤半年后，这位运动员终于重新回到了赛场。
quiz.en: Six months after his injury, the athlete finally returned to competition.

example.zh: 机器代替了人力，工厂的效率提高了很多。
example.en: Machines have replaced manual labour, and the factory's efficiency has risen a lot.

quiz.zh: 这项工程需要投入大量的人力和物力。
quiz.en: This project requires a huge investment of manpower and materials.

低头.gloss: to lower one's head; to give in

example.zh: 她害羞地低头笑了笑，一句话也没说。
example.en: She lowered her head and smiled shyly without saying a word.

quiz.zh: 现在很多人走路时都低头看手机，非常危险。
quiz.en: Nowadays lots of people look down at their phones while walking, which is very dangerous.

example.zh: 父母都希望子女将来能过上好日子。
example.en: All parents hope their children will have a good life in the future.

quiz.zh: 公司为员工子女提供免费的暑期托管服务。
quiz.en: The company provides free summer childcare for employees' children.

面向.gloss: to face; to be aimed at, oriented toward

example.zh: 我家的阳台面向大海，风景特别好。
example.en: Our balcony faces the sea and has a wonderful view.

quiz.zh: 这门课程主要面向零基础的初学者。
quiz.en: This course is mainly aimed at complete beginners.

example.zh: 现在的消费者买东西时越来越重视质量。
example.en: Today's consumers care more and more about quality when they shop.

quiz.zh: 商家虚假宣传，严重侵害了消费者的权益。
quiz.en: The merchant's false advertising seriously violated consumers' rights.

example.zh: 大城市的住房价格太高，年轻人很难买得起。
example.en: Housing in big cities is so expensive that young people can hardly afford it.

quiz.zh: 政府计划新建一批保障性住房，帮助低收入家庭。
quiz.en: The government plans to build a batch of affordable housing to help low-income families.

此后.gloss: after this; afterwards; from then on

example.zh: 他们十年前见过一面，此后再也没有联系过。
example.en: They met once ten years ago and have never been in touch since.

quiz.zh: 他十八岁离开家，此后一直在北京工作。
quiz.en: He left home at eighteen and has worked in Beijing ever since.

example.zh: 这个动人的故事让在场的人都流下了眼泪。
example.en: This moving story brought everyone present to tears.

quiz.zh: 她的歌声非常动人，大家都听得入了迷。
quiz.en: Her singing was so moving that everyone was spellbound.

example.zh: 适量喝茶对身体是有益的，但不要喝得太浓。
example.en: Drinking tea in moderation is good for you, but don't drink it too strong.

quiz.zh: 参加志愿活动对我来说是一次非常有益的经历。
quiz.en: Volunteering was a very worthwhile experience for me.

example.zh: 天气好的时候，孩子们应该多去户外活动。
example.en: When the weather is nice, children should spend more time playing outdoors.

quiz.zh: 他特别喜欢爬山、露营这样的户外运动。
quiz.en: He loves outdoor activities like hiking and camping.

example.zh: 地震发生后，灾区急需大量饮用水和药品。
example.en: After the earthquake, the disaster area urgently needs large amounts of drinking water and medicine.

quiz.zh: 医院现在急需O型血，希望市民踊跃献血。
quiz.en: The hospital urgently needs type O blood and hopes people will come forward to donate.

凭借.gloss: to rely on; by virtue of; by means of

example.zh: 她凭借出色的表演获得了最佳女演员奖。
example.en: She won the Best Actress award for her outstanding performance.

quiz.zh: 这家小公司凭借过硬的技术，在市场上站稳了脚跟。
quiz.en: Thanks to its solid technology, this small company has gained a firm foothold in the market.

看作.gloss: to regard as; to look upon as

example.zh: 很多人把读书看作改变命运的唯一出路。
example.en: Many people see studying as the only way to change their fate.

quiz.zh: 别客气，我一直把你看作自己的亲妹妹。
quiz.en: Don't be so polite; I've always thought of you as my own little sister.

example.zh: 冬天的橘子又甜又多汁，我一次能吃好几个。
example.en: Tangerines in winter are sweet and juicy; I can eat several at a time.

quiz.zh: 这种橘子皮很薄，用手一剥就开了。
quiz.en: These tangerines have very thin skin and peel easily by hand.

example.zh: 今晚剧场里有一场话剧演出，票早就卖完了。
example.en: There's a play on at the theatre tonight, and the tickets sold out long ago.

quiz.zh: 演出快开始了，观众们陆续走进剧场找座位。
quiz.en: The show was about to start, and the audience filed into the theatre to find their seats.

example.zh: 吸烟对身体有害，这是大家都知道的。
example.en: Everyone knows smoking is bad for your health.

quiz.zh: 这种塑料加热后会释放出有害物质。
quiz.en: This plastic gives off harmful substances when heated.

开业.gloss: to open for business; to start a business

example.zh: 我们小区门口那家超市装修好了，明天正式开业。
example.en: The supermarket at the entrance to our neighbourhood has finished its fit-out and officially opens tomorrow.

quiz.zh: 这家餐厅开业第一天，所有菜都打五折。
quiz.en: On the restaurant's first day of business, every dish was half price.

example.zh: 这家书店的图书种类很多，什么书都能找到。
example.en: This bookshop has a huge range of books; you can find anything there.

quiz.zh: 这个网站上的图书经常打折，比实体店便宜不少。
quiz.en: Books on this website are often on sale and much cheaper than in physical shops.

example.zh: 听到儿子考上大学的消息，妈妈的眼里充满了泪水。
example.en: When she heard her son had got into university, the mother's eyes filled with tears.

quiz.zh: 比赛结束的那一刻，他再也控制不住，泪水夺眶而出。
quiz.en: The moment the match ended, he couldn't hold back any longer and tears streamed from his eyes.

example.zh: 出门前要记得关掉家里的电器。
example.en: Remember to switch off the electrical appliances at home before you go out.

quiz.zh: 这个插座同时插了太多电器，很容易出问题。
quiz.en: Too many appliances are plugged into this socket at once; that can easily cause trouble.

步行.gloss: to walk; to go on foot

example.zh: 我家离学校很近，每天步行上学。
example.en: I live close to school, so I walk there every day.

quiz.zh: 从这里步行到地铁站大概只要五分钟。
quiz.en: It's only about a five-minute walk from here to the subway station.

example.zh: 孩子用彩色铅笔画了一幅春天的画。
example.en: The child drew a picture of spring with coloured pencils.

quiz.zh: 以前的电视只有黑白的，后来才有了彩色电视。
quiz.en: TVs used to be only black and white; colour TV came later.

上涨.gloss: to rise; to go up (prices, water level)

example.zh: 最近菜价上涨得很厉害，买菜都得精打细算。
example.en: Vegetable prices have risen sharply lately, so you have to budget carefully when shopping.

quiz.zh: 连续下了几天大雨，河里的水位不断上涨。
quiz.en: After several days of heavy rain, the river level kept rising.

收看.gloss: to watch (a TV program or broadcast)

example.zh: 每年除夕，全国有几亿人收看春节联欢晚会。
example.en: Every New Year's Eve, hundreds of millions of people across the country watch the Spring Festival Gala.

quiz.zh: 观众朋友们，欢迎收看今天的新闻节目。
quiz.en: Good evening, viewers, and welcome to today's news programme.

example.zh: 这家公司的产品已经销往海外几十个国家。
example.en: This company's products are now sold in dozens of countries overseas.

quiz.zh: 春节期间，很多海外华人也会以各种方式庆祝。
quiz.en: During the Spring Festival, many overseas Chinese also celebrate in various ways.

example.zh: 他大学毕业后考上了公务员，在市政府工作。
example.en: After graduating he passed the civil service exam and now works for the city government.

quiz.zh: 每年报考公务员的人数都在增加，竞争非常激烈。
quiz.en: The number of people applying to be civil servants grows every year, and competition is fierce.

example.zh: 穿羽绒服可以减少身体热量的散失。
example.en: Wearing a down jacket reduces the loss of body heat.

quiz.zh: 炸鸡的热量很高，减肥期间最好少吃。
quiz.en: Fried chicken is high in calories, so it's best to eat less of it while dieting.

早晚.gloss: morning and evening; sooner or later
早晚.indonesian: pagi dan malam; cepat atau lambat

example.zh: 这种药一天吃两次，早晚各一次。
example.en: Take this medicine twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening.

quiz.zh: 你骗了他这么多次，他早晚会发现的。
quiz.en: You've lied to him so many times; he'll find out sooner or later.

亏.gloss: to lose (money); to suffer a loss

example.zh: 这次投资他亏了十几万，心情很不好。
example.en: He lost over a hundred thousand yuan on this investment and is feeling terrible.

quiz.zh: 这家店开了一年一直在亏钱，老板只好把它关了。
quiz.en: The shop lost money for a whole year, so the owner had to close it.

example.zh: 这条裤子的长度刚好合适，不用再改了。
example.en: These trousers are just the right length; they don't need altering.

quiz.zh: 这篇作文的长度不能少于八百字。
quiz.en: This essay must be at least eight hundred characters long.

example.zh: 双方经过多次谈判，终于签订了合作协议。
example.en: After many rounds of negotiation, the two sides finally signed a cooperation agreement.

quiz.zh: 入职第一天，公司就和他签订了三年的劳动合同。
quiz.en: On his first day, the company signed a three-year employment contract with him.

迎.gloss: to welcome; to greet; to go to meet

example.zh: 春节前，家家户户都贴春联迎新年。
example.en: Before the Spring Festival, every household puts up couplets to welcome the New Year.

quiz.zh: 听说老同学要来，他一大早就跑到村口去迎他。
quiz.en: Hearing that his old classmate was coming, he ran to the village entrance first thing in the morning to meet him.

example.zh: 公园的湖里有几只鸭子在游来游去。
example.en: A few ducks are swimming around on the lake in the park.

quiz.zh: 奶奶在院子里养了几只鸡和鸭子，每天都能捡到蛋。
quiz.en: Grandma keeps a few chickens and ducks in the yard and collects eggs every day.

example.zh: 这辆车停在路中间，警察正在联系车主。
example.en: This car is parked in the middle of the road, and the police are trying to contact the owner.

quiz.zh: 很多车主都选择在网上购买汽车保险。
quiz.en: Many car owners choose to buy their car insurance online.

example.zh: 中秋节晚上，一家人坐在院子里赏月。
example.en: On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, the family sat in the yard admiring the moon.

quiz.zh: 每年春天，很多人专门去公园赏花。
quiz.en: Every spring, lots of people go to the park specially to enjoy the flowers.

引进.gloss: to introduce (from outside); to bring in, to import

example.zh: 这家工厂从国外引进了一套先进的生产设备。
example.en: This factory brought in a set of advanced production equipment from abroad.

quiz.zh: 为了发展经济，这座城市积极引进各类人才。
quiz.en: To develop its economy, the city is actively bringing in talent of all kinds.

充电.gloss: to charge (a battery); to recharge oneself (by learning)

example.zh: 我的手机快没电了，得赶紧充电。
example.en: My phone's almost dead; I need to charge it right away.

quiz.zh: 工作几年后，他觉得自己需要充电，就报了个研究生课程。
quiz.en: After working a few years, he felt he needed to recharge, so he enrolled in a postgraduate course.

example.zh: 超市正在搞促销，很多商品都买一送一。
example.en: The supermarket is running a promotion, with lots of items buy one, get one free.

quiz.zh: 商家常常利用节假日进行促销，吸引更多顾客。
quiz.en: Merchants often use holidays to run promotions and attract more customers.

example.zh: 饭菜有点凉了，放进微波炉加热一下吧。
example.en: The food has gone a bit cold; put it in the microwave to heat it up.

quiz.zh: 水加热到一百度就会开始沸腾。
quiz.en: Water starts to boil when it's heated to one hundred degrees.

example.zh: 现在很多人骑电动自行车上班，又快又方便。
example.en: Lots of people now ride e-bikes to work; it's fast and convenient.

quiz.zh: 这款电动牙刷充一次电可以用一个月。
quiz.en: This electric toothbrush lasts a month on a single charge.

example.zh: 番茄炒鸡蛋是一道很受欢迎的家常菜。
example.en: Tomato and scrambled egg is a very popular home-style dish.

quiz.zh: 这种番茄酱酸酸甜甜的，配薯条特别好吃。
quiz.en: This ketchup is sweet and tangy and goes great with fries.

example.zh: 我的护照下个月就到期了，得赶快去办新的。
example.en: My passport expires next month; I need to get a new one quickly.

quiz.zh: 租房合同快到期了，房东问我还续不续租。
quiz.en: My lease is about to run out, and the landlord asked whether I'll renew.

example.zh: 他长得又高大又结实，一看就是运动员。
example.en: He's tall and sturdy; you can tell at a glance he's an athlete.

quiz.zh: 公园门口种着两排高大的树，夏天特别凉快。
quiz.en: Two rows of tall trees line the park entrance, so it's lovely and cool in summer.

example.zh: 这部动画片讲的是一只小熊猫的故事。
example.en: This cartoon tells the story of a little panda.

quiz.zh: 他大学学的是动画设计，现在在一家游戏公司工作。
quiz.en: He studied animation design at university and now works for a games company.

研制.gloss: to research and produce; to develop (equipment, medicine)

example.zh: 科学家们经过多年努力，终于研制出了这种新药。
example.en: After years of work, the scientists finally developed this new drug.

quiz.zh: 一九六四年，中国第一颗原子弹研制成功。
quiz.en: In 1964, China successfully developed its first atomic bomb.

成年.gloss: to come of age; to become an adult; adult

example.zh: 在中国，年满十八岁就算成年了。
example.en: In China, you are considered an adult once you turn eighteen.

quiz.zh: 孩子已经成年了，有些事应该让他自己做决定。
quiz.en: He's an adult now; some things he should decide for himself.

example.zh: 这家工厂规模很大，有两千多名职工。
example.en: This is a big factory with more than two thousand workers.

quiz.zh: 单位每年都组织职工免费体检。
quiz.en: The work unit arranges a free health check for its staff every year.

example.zh: 做决定不能只看眼前，要从长远考虑。
example.en: When making decisions, don't just look at the present; think about the long term.

quiz.zh: 保护环境关系到国家的长远发展。
quiz.en: Protecting the environment matters for the country's long-term development.

example.zh: 这座建筑的外形像一只鸟，非常特别。
example.en: This building is shaped like a bird; it's really unusual.

quiz.zh: 这种动物外形很像老鼠，其实跟老鼠没什么关系。
quiz.en: This animal looks a lot like a mouse but isn't actually related to mice.

赠.gloss: to give as a present; to present

example.zh: 凡在本店消费满一百元，即赠一瓶饮料。
example.en: Spend over one hundred yuan in our shop and get a free drink.

quiz.zh: 这本书是作者签名后亲手赠给我的。
quiz.en: The author signed this book and gave it to me personally.

大爷.gloss: uncle (polite address for an older man); elderly man

example.zh: 大爷，请问去火车站应该怎么走？
example.en: Excuse me, sir, which way is it to the train station?

quiz.zh: 楼下那位大爷退休前是老师，他每天早上都在公园里打太极拳。
quiz.en: The old man downstairs was a teacher before he retired; he does tai chi in the park every morning.

example.zh: 在这个城市里，他一个熟人都没有。
example.en: He doesn't know a single person in this city.

quiz.zh: 他想通过熟人帮忙找工作，结果被骗了钱。
quiz.en: He tried to find a job through someone he knew and ended up being cheated out of money.

example.zh: 创业初期，公司只有三个员工。
example.en: In the early days of the business, the company had only three employees.

quiz.zh: 这种病在初期没有明显症状，很容易被忽视。
quiz.en: This disease has no obvious symptoms in its early stage, so it's easily overlooked.

example.zh: 现在很多大学都开设了在线课程。
example.en: Many universities now offer online courses.

quiz.zh: 他的头像是灰的，说明他现在不在线。
quiz.en: His profile picture is greyed out, which means he's not online right now.

example.zh: 中国有很多河流，其中最长的是长江。
example.en: China has many rivers, the longest of which is the Yangtze.

quiz.zh: 工厂把污水直接排进附近的河流，造成了严重污染。
quiz.en: The factory dumped waste water straight into a nearby river, causing serious pollution.

通行.gloss: to pass through; to go through (of traffic)

example.zh: 前方道路正在维修，车辆暂时无法通行。
example.en: The road ahead is under repair, and vehicles can't get through for now.

quiz.zh: 这座桥只允许行人和自行车通行。
quiz.en: Only pedestrians and bicycles are allowed to cross this bridge.

example.zh: 我们这一代人小时候没有手机，也玩得很开心。
example.en: Our generation had no mobile phones as kids, and we still had lots of fun.

quiz.zh: 新一代年轻人更注重生活质量。
quiz.en: The new generation of young people care more about quality of life.

example.zh: 今天是我们结婚十周年纪念日。
example.en: Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.

quiz.zh: 这个纪念日是为了纪念在大地震中遇难的人。
quiz.en: This day of remembrance commemorates those who died in the great earthquake.

example.zh: 学校聘请了一位外国专家来教英语。
example.en: The school has hired a foreign expert to teach English.

quiz.zh: 公司打算聘请一位有经验的律师来处理这件事。
quiz.en: The company plans to hire an experienced lawyer to handle the matter.

example.zh: 这家医院的门诊每天早上八点开始挂号。
example.en: This hospital's outpatient department starts registering patients at eight every morning.

quiz.zh: 他只是轻微感冒，在门诊开了点药就回家了。
quiz.en: He just had a slight cold, so he got some medicine at the outpatient clinic and went home.

example.zh: 他从小就喜欢收集邮票，已经有上千张了。
example.en: He's loved collecting stamps since he was a kid and now has over a thousand.

quiz.zh: 寄信前别忘了在信封上贴好邮票。
quiz.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on the envelope before you post the letter.

开幕.gloss: to open (a ceremony, exhibition, or meeting); the curtain rises

example.zh: 国际电影节将于下周三在上海开幕。
example.en: The international film festival will open in Shanghai next Wednesday.

quiz.zh: 展览开幕当天，来参观的人排起了长队。
quiz.en: On the day the exhibition opened, visitors formed a long queue.

example.zh: 这里雨水充足，山上的树木长得非常茂盛。
example.en: There is plenty of rain here, and the trees on the mountain grow very thickly.

quiz.zh: 为了修路，这里的很多树木被砍掉了。
quiz.en: Many of the trees here were cut down to build the road.

example.zh: 大熊猫是中国特有的珍稀动物。
example.en: The giant panda is a rare animal found only in China.

quiz.zh: 这道菜有一种当地特有的香味，别的地方吃不到。
quiz.en: This dish has a flavour unique to the area that you can't find anywhere else.

example.zh: 爸爸生日时，我送了他一条蓝色的领带。
example.en: For Dad's birthday I gave him a blue tie.

quiz.zh: 他今天穿得很正式，还系了一条红领带。
quiz.en: He's dressed very formally today, even wearing a red tie.

example.zh: 我每天早上闹钟一响就起床。
example.en: I get up every morning as soon as my alarm goes off.

quiz.zh: 他昨晚忘了定闹钟，结果上班迟到了。
quiz.en: He forgot to set his alarm last night and was late for work.

example.zh: 如果一次买得多，老板一般都会给点折扣。
example.en: If you buy a lot at once, the owner will usually give you a bit of a discount.

quiz.zh: 这家店的折扣力度很大，很多衣服只要半价。
quiz.en: This shop's discounts are huge; lots of clothes are half price.

先后.gloss: order, sequence; one after another, successively

example.zh: 他先后去过十几个国家，见识非常广。
example.en: He has been to more than a dozen countries over the years and is very well-travelled.

quiz.zh: 这两位科学家先后获得了诺贝尔奖。
quiz.en: These two scientists won the Nobel Prize one after the other.

example.zh: 孩子手里拿着一个红色的气球，高兴地跑来跑去。
example.en: The child ran around happily holding a red balloon.

quiz.zh: 生日派对上，房间里挂满了五颜六色的气球。
quiz.en: At the birthday party, the room was full of colourful balloons.

敢于.gloss: to dare to; to have the courage to

example.zh: 年轻人要敢于尝试新事物，不要怕失败。
example.en: Young people should dare to try new things and not be afraid of failing.

quiz.zh: 一个好的领导应该敢于承认自己的错误。
quiz.en: A good leader should have the courage to admit their own mistakes.

example.zh: 爸爸每天晚上都在书房看书到很晚。
example.en: Dad reads in his study until late every night.

quiz.zh: 他把家里最小的房间改成了书房，放满了书架。
quiz.en: He turned the smallest room in the house into a study and filled it with bookshelves.

example.zh: 今年全校学生总数已经超过了五千人。
example.en: The school's total enrolment has passed five thousand this year.

quiz.zh: 统计显示，参加活动的人中女性占总数的六成。
quiz.en: Figures show that women made up sixty percent of the total participants.

example.zh: 这种蘑菇有毒，千万不能食用。
example.en: This mushroom is poisonous and must never be eaten.

quiz.zh: 牛奶开封后请放进冰箱，并在三天内食用。
quiz.en: Once opened, keep the milk in the fridge and consume within three days.

大于.gloss: to be greater than; to be more than

example.zh: 这次改革带来的好处远远大于坏处。
example.en: The benefits of this reform far outweigh the drawbacks.

quiz.zh: 如果支出长期大于收入，家庭就会陷入困难。
quiz.en: If spending exceeds income for a long time, the family will run into trouble.

example.zh: 这个项目已经进入中期，进展比较顺利。
example.en: This project has reached its middle phase and is going fairly smoothly.

quiz.zh: 公司制订了一个五年的中期发展计划。
quiz.en: The company has drawn up a five-year medium-term development plan.

example.zh: 这个盒子里头装的是什么？这么重。
example.en: What's inside this box? It's so heavy.

quiz.zh: 外面太冷了，快到里头来坐吧。
quiz.en: It's too cold out there; come inside and sit down.

存放.gloss: to store; to leave (in someone's care)

example.zh: 这些药品要存放在阴凉干燥的地方。
example.en: These medicines should be stored in a cool, dry place.

quiz.zh: 酒店前台可以帮客人免费存放行李。
quiz.en: The hotel front desk can keep guests' luggage for free.

example.zh: 他大学毕业后留在学校从事科研工作。
example.en: After graduating, he stayed at the university to do scientific research.

quiz.zh: 她是一名科研人员，每天都在实验室里做实验。
quiz.en: She's a researcher who spends every day doing experiments in the lab.

example.zh: 工厂采用的这种新方法既高效又节能。
example.en: The new method the factory has adopted is both efficient and energy-saving.

quiz.zh: 要想高效学习，首先要制订合理的计划。
quiz.en: If you want to study efficiently, you first need a sensible plan.

example.zh: 这棵树的叶子被虫子吃掉了一大半。
example.en: Most of this tree's leaves have been eaten by insects.

quiz.zh: 夏天开着窗户，很容易有虫子飞进来。
quiz.en: If you leave the window open in summer, bugs fly in easily.

example.zh: 这是他第一次出国，此前他连飞机都没坐过。
example.en: This is his first trip abroad; before this he had never even been on a plane.

quiz.zh: 警方表示，嫌疑人此前已有多次犯罪记录。
quiz.en: Police said the suspect already had several previous criminal records.

example.zh: 东北产的大米特别香，煮出来的饭很好吃。
example.en: Rice from the Northeast is especially fragrant and cooks up delicious.

quiz.zh: 超市里的大米一袋十公斤，价格不贵。
quiz.en: Rice at the supermarket comes in ten-kilo bags and isn't expensive.

失恋.gloss: to be jilted; to suffer a breakup

example.zh: 她刚失恋，这几天心情一直不太好。
example.en: She's just been through a breakup and has been feeling down these past few days.

quiz.zh: 失恋以后，他把所有时间都花在了工作上。
quiz.en: After the breakup, he poured all his time into work.

example.zh: 这些瓷器的制作工艺非常复杂。
example.en: The craftsmanship involved in making this porcelain is very complex.

quiz.zh: 这家工厂采用新工艺以后，产品质量大大提高。
quiz.en: Since this factory adopted a new process, its product quality has greatly improved.

领取.gloss: to receive; to collect, to draw (what is issued)

example.zh: 考试结束后，请到办公室领取成绩单。
example.en: After the exam, please collect your transcript from the office.

quiz.zh: 快递已经到了，请凭取件码到驿站领取。
quiz.en: Your parcel has arrived; please collect it at the pickup point with your pickup code.

展出.gloss: to exhibit; to put on display

example.zh: 这批文物将在国家博物馆展出三个月。
example.en: These cultural relics will be on display at the National Museum for three months.

quiz.zh: 这次画展一共展出了两百多幅作品。
quiz.en: This art exhibition showed more than two hundred works in total.

example.zh: 一个路人看到有人晕倒，马上打了急救电话。
example.en: A passerby saw someone faint and immediately called an ambulance.

quiz.zh: 他迷路了，只好向路人打听回酒店怎么走。
quiz.en: He got lost and had to ask passers-by how to get back to the hotel.

example.zh: 这家店只卖优质水果，价格当然也贵一些。
example.en: This shop sells only top-quality fruit, so of course it's a bit pricier.

quiz.zh: 公司始终坚持为客户提供优质的服务。
quiz.en: The company has always been committed to providing customers with high-quality service.

example.zh: 进门请换拖鞋，不要穿鞋进屋。
example.en: Please change into slippers when you come in; don't wear shoes in the house.

quiz.zh: 夏天他总是穿着拖鞋去楼下买东西。
quiz.en: In summer he always pops downstairs to the shops in his flip-flops.

example.zh: 她大学毕业后去山区当了一名老师。
example.en: After graduating, she went to teach in a mountain area.

quiz.zh: 山区交通不方便，孩子们上学要走很远的路。
quiz.en: Transport in the mountains is poor, so children have to walk a long way to school.

example.zh: 这部电影上映后获得了观众的一致好评。
example.en: After its release, the film was unanimously praised by audiences.

quiz.zh: 这家餐厅在网上的好评很多，周末总要排队。
quiz.en: This restaurant has lots of good reviews online, so there's always a queue at weekends.

example.zh: 他上个月刚拿到驾照，还不太敢上高速。
example.en: He only got his driving licence last month and doesn't dare drive on the motorway yet.

quiz.zh: 警察让司机出示驾照和行驶证。
quiz.en: The police officer asked the driver to show his driving licence and vehicle registration.

example.zh: 西瓜的水分很多，夏天吃最解渴。
example.en: Watermelon is very juicy, so it's the best thing for quenching thirst in summer.

quiz.zh: 运动出汗后，要及时补充身体流失的水分。
quiz.en: After sweating from exercise, you should promptly replace the fluids your body has lost.

example.zh: 这家公司的产品太单一，很难满足市场需求。
example.en: This company's product range is too narrow to meet market demand.

quiz.zh: 孩子的饮食不能太单一，要注意营养均衡。
quiz.en: Children's diets shouldn't be too monotonous; make sure their nutrition is balanced.

example.zh: 刚工作的时候，他买了一辆二手车。
example.en: When he first started working, he bought a second-hand car.

quiz.zh: 毕业前，很多学生会把旧书拿到二手市场去卖。
quiz.en: Before graduating, many students take their old books to the second-hand market to sell.

example.zh: 这座城市近几年发展很快，变得越来越现代化了。
example.en: This city has developed fast in recent years and become more and more modern.

quiz.zh: 工厂引进新设备以后，基本实现了生产的现代化。
quiz.en: After bringing in new equipment, the factory has largely modernised its production.

example.zh: 勤俭节约是中华民族的优良传统。
example.en: Hard work and thrift are a fine tradition of the Chinese nation.

quiz.zh: 这里的水稻品种优良，产量比别处高出不少。
quiz.en: The rice varieties here are excellent, and yields are much higher than elsewhere.

example.zh: 父母为了儿女，什么苦都愿意吃。
example.en: Parents will endure any hardship for their children.

quiz.zh: 她有一双儿女，儿子十岁，女儿八岁。
quiz.en: She has a son and a daughter; the boy is ten and the girl is eight.

example.zh: 请把你的银行账号发给我，我马上转钱给你。
example.en: Send me your bank account number and I'll transfer the money right away.

quiz.zh: 他的游戏账号被人盗了，里面的装备全没了。
quiz.en: His game account was hacked, and all his gear is gone.

example.zh: 这次旅游的费用包括交通和住宿。
example.en: The cost of this trip covers transport and accommodation.

quiz.zh: 学校为外地学生提供免费住宿。
quiz.en: The school offers free accommodation to students from out of town.

example.zh: 火车快进站了，请大家在站台上排好队。
example.en: The train is about to arrive; please queue up on the platform.

quiz.zh: 他站在站台上，一直看着火车开远了才离开。
quiz.en: He stood on the platform watching until the train was far away before he left.

example.zh: 飞机在跑道上加速，很快就起飞了。
example.en: The plane sped down the runway and soon took off.

quiz.zh: 每天傍晚，学校操场的跑道上都有很多人在跑步。
quiz.en: Every evening there are lots of people running on the track at the school sports ground.

example.zh: 一场暴雨过后，街上到处都是积水。
example.en: After the downpour, the streets were flooded everywhere.

quiz.zh: 气象台发布了暴雨预警，提醒市民尽量不要外出。
quiz.en: The weather service issued a rainstorm warning, advising people to stay indoors if possible.

example.zh: 新系统上线后，原有的数据都不会丢失。
example.en: When the new system goes live, none of the existing data will be lost.

quiz.zh: 在原有基础上，今年的产量又提高了百分之十。
quiz.en: Building on what was already there, output rose by a further ten percent this year.

试用.gloss: to try out; to be on probation

example.zh: 这个软件可以免费试用三十天。
example.en: You can try this software free for thirty days.

quiz.zh: 新员工要先试用三个月，表现好才能转正。
quiz.en: New staff are on probation for three months and only become permanent if they do well.

example.zh: 今年夏天雨水特别多，好几个地方都发了大水。
example.en: There's been a lot of rain this summer, and several places have flooded.

quiz.zh: 他们在屋顶上装了设备，把雨水收集起来浇花。
quiz.en: They've put equipment on the roof to collect rainwater for watering the flowers.

example.zh: 我们这次是跟旅行社去的，什么都不用操心。
example.en: We went with a travel agency this time, so we didn't have to worry about anything.

quiz.zh: 她在一家旅行社当导游，经常带团出国。
quiz.en: She works as a tour guide for a travel agency and often takes groups abroad.

example.zh: 厨房的柜子里放满了碗和盘子。
example.en: The kitchen cupboards are full of bowls and plates.

quiz.zh: 衣服买得太多了，柜子已经装不下了。
quiz.en: I've bought so many clothes that the wardrobe can't hold them all.

example.zh: 孩子们在海边用沙子堆了一座城堡。
example.en: The children built a sandcastle on the beach.

quiz.zh: 刮了一天大风，窗台上落了厚厚一层沙子。
quiz.en: After a whole day of strong wind, a thick layer of sand had settled on the windowsill.

example.zh: 数学是很多学科的基础，一定要学好。
example.en: Mathematics is the foundation of many disciplines, so you must learn it well.

quiz.zh: 这所大学的优势学科是计算机和医学。
quiz.en: This university's strongest subjects are computer science and medicine.

example.zh: 今年的粮食产量比去年增加了百分之五。
example.en: This year's grain output is five percent higher than last year's.

quiz.zh: 由于天气干旱，今年苹果的产量大大减少。
quiz.en: Because of the drought, this year's apple harvest has fallen sharply.

example.zh: 他在餐饮行业干了十多年，开了三家饭馆。
example.en: He has worked in the restaurant business for over ten years and opened three restaurants.

quiz.zh: 受疫情影响，很多餐饮企业的收入大幅下降。
quiz.en: Hit by the pandemic, many food and beverage businesses saw their income plunge.

舍得.gloss: to be willing to part with; not to grudge

example.zh: 她平时很节约，但给孩子买书却很舍得花钱。
example.en: She's usually very thrifty, but she never begrudges spending money on books for her kids.

quiz.zh: 这只小狗陪了他十年，他怎么舍得送人呢？
quiz.en: That dog has been with him for ten years; how could he bear to give it away?

大妈.gloss: aunt (polite address for an older woman); middle-aged or elderly woman
大妈.indonesian: bibi; ibu (sapaan untuk wanita paruh baya)

example.zh: 每天晚上，小区里的大妈们都在广场上跳舞。
example.en: Every evening the older ladies in the neighbourhood dance in the square.

quiz.zh: 这位大妈年轻时是个裁缝，她做的衣服可漂亮了。
quiz.en: This lady was a tailor when she was young, and the clothes she made were beautiful.

example.zh: 这部关于大熊猫的纪录片拍得非常好。
example.en: This documentary about giant pandas is extremely well made.

quiz.zh: 他最近迷上了历史纪录片，每天晚上都看一集。
quiz.en: He's hooked on history documentaries lately and watches an episode every night.

example.zh: 比赛结束时，他全身都被汗水湿透了。
example.en: By the end of the match he was drenched in sweat.

quiz.zh: 今天的成功是靠多年的汗水换来的。
quiz.en: Today's success was earned through years of hard work.

离职.gloss: to resign; to leave one's job

example.zh: 他因为工资太低，上个月离职了。
example.en: He quit last month because the pay was too low.

quiz.zh: 离职之前，你得把手上的工作交接清楚。
quiz.en: Before you leave the job, you need to hand over your work properly.

带动.gloss: to drive; to spur on; to bring along

example.zh: 旅游业的发展带动了当地经济。
example.en: The growth of tourism has boosted the local economy.

quiz.zh: 在他的带动下，全班同学都爱上了跑步。
quiz.en: Inspired by his example, the whole class came to love running.

example.zh: 这些年城区面积不断扩大，很多农田变成了小区。
example.en: The urban area has kept expanding in recent years, and lots of farmland has become housing estates.

quiz.zh: 为了减少污染，大货车白天不能进入城区。
quiz.en: To cut pollution, heavy lorries aren't allowed into the city during the day.

example.zh: 每年春节前，都有大批在外打工的人回老家过年。
example.en: Every year before the Spring Festival, huge numbers of migrant workers go home for the holiday.

quiz.zh: 工厂刚生产了一大批口罩，马上就要送往医院。
quiz.en: The factory has just produced a large batch of masks that will be sent to hospitals right away.

example.zh: 正如大家所说，这次比赛的结果出人意料。
example.en: Just as everyone said, the result of this competition was unexpected.

quiz.zh: 正如老师预料的那样，这道题很多同学都做错了。
quiz.en: Just as the teacher expected, many students got this question wrong.

制订.gloss: to formulate; to work out, to draw up (a plan)

example.zh: 考试前，他为自己制订了一个详细的复习计划。
example.en: Before the exam, he drew up a detailed revision plan for himself.

quiz.zh: 老师根据每个学生的情况，制订了不同的学习计划。
quiz.en: Based on each student's situation, the teacher drew up a different study plan for each.

example.zh: 这座老房子的外观没变，里面却全部重新装修了。
example.en: The outside of this old house hasn't changed, but the inside has been completely redone.

quiz.zh: 这款手机外观设计简洁大方，很受年轻人喜欢。
quiz.en: This phone's sleek, simple design is very popular with young people.

example.zh: 通过这次交流，两国人民加深了相互了解。
example.en: Through this exchange, the people of the two countries deepened their mutual understanding.

quiz.zh: 这条河太浅，船过不去，得把河道加深一些。
quiz.en: This river is too shallow for boats to get through; the channel needs to be deepened.

调研.gloss: to investigate; to do research (survey, fact-finding)

example.zh: 市长亲自到农村调研，了解农民的实际困难。
example.en: The mayor went to the countryside himself to look into farmers' real difficulties.

quiz.zh: 推出新产品前，公司先做了大量的市场调研。
quiz.en: Before launching the new product, the company did a lot of market research.

example.zh: 她特别胆小，晚上一个人不敢出门。
example.en: She's really timid and doesn't dare go out alone at night.

quiz.zh: 别看这只狗个子大，其实胆小得很，见了猫就跑。
quiz.en: This dog may be big, but it's a real coward; it runs away whenever it sees a cat.

example.zh: 他大学学的是影视表演，现在是一名演员。
example.en: He studied film and TV acting at university and is now an actor.

quiz.zh: 这座古城经常被用来拍摄影视作品。
quiz.en: This ancient town is often used as a location for films and TV dramas.

超速.gloss: to speed; to exceed the speed limit

example.zh: 他开车超速被拍到了，罚了两百块钱。
example.en: He was caught on camera speeding and fined two hundred yuan.

quiz.zh: 这条路限速六十公里，超速行驶非常危险。
quiz.en: The speed limit on this road is sixty kilometres an hour; speeding is very dangerous.

example.zh: 国庆期间，各大景点都人山人海。
example.en: During the National Day holiday, all the major tourist spots are packed.

quiz.zh: 今年国庆放七天假，我们打算回老家看看。
quiz.en: We get seven days off for National Day this year, so we plan to visit our hometown.

example.zh: 请大家花五分钟填一下这份问卷。
example.en: Please take five minutes to fill in this questionnaire.

quiz.zh: 研究人员通过网上问卷调查了一千多名大学生。
quiz.en: The researchers surveyed more than a thousand university students with an online questionnaire.

增进.gloss: to enhance; to promote, to further (friendship, understanding)

example.zh: 这次交流活动增进了两校学生之间的友谊。
example.en: This exchange strengthened the friendship between students of the two schools.

quiz.zh: 适当运动可以增进食欲，也能改善睡眠。
quiz.en: Moderate exercise can boost your appetite and improve your sleep.

example.zh: 这次改革对中国经济产生了深远的影响。
example.en: This reform had a far-reaching impact on China's economy.

quiz.zh: 孔子的思想对整个东亚文化都影响深远。
quiz.en: Confucius's ideas have profoundly influenced the whole of East Asian culture.

example.zh: 电视声音太大了，把音量调小一点吧。
example.en: The TV is too loud; turn the volume down a bit.

quiz.zh: 他戴着耳机，音量开得很大，连我叫他都没听见。
quiz.en: He had his headphones on with the volume turned way up and didn't even hear me call him.

年夜饭.gloss: New Year's Eve dinner (family reunion dinner)
年夜饭.indonesian: makan malam Tahun Baru Imlek (malam reuni keluarga)

example.zh: 除夕晚上，全家人围在一起吃年夜饭。
example.en: On New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers round for the reunion dinner.

quiz.zh: 现在很多家庭选择在饭店订年夜饭，省得自己做。
quiz.en: Many families now book their New Year's Eve dinner at a restaurant to save cooking themselves.

example.zh: 他们俩从小一起长大，感情非常深厚。
example.en: The two of them grew up together and are very close.

quiz.zh: 这位老教授有着深厚的文学功底。
quiz.en: This old professor has a profound grounding in literature.

涨价.gloss: to go up in price; to raise prices

example.zh: 听说下个月地铁票要涨价了。
example.en: I hear subway fares are going up next month.

quiz.zh: 猪肉又涨价了，一斤比上个月贵了五块钱。
quiz.en: Pork has gone up again; it's five yuan more per jin than last month.

example.zh: 无论走多远，亲情都是割不断的。
example.en: No matter how far you go, the bonds of family can never be broken.

quiz.zh: 这部电影讲的是父女之间的亲情，很多观众都看哭了。
quiz.en: This film is about the love between a father and his daughter, and it moved many viewers to tears.

example.zh: 请在这里写上你的姓名和住址。
example.en: Please write your name and address here.

quiz.zh: 快递员找不到地方，打电话来问我的详细住址。
quiz.en: The courier couldn't find the place and called to ask for my exact address.

要不是.gloss: if it were not for; but for

example.zh: 要不是你提醒我，我今天肯定忘了带钥匙。
example.en: If you hadn't reminded me, I'd definitely have forgotten my keys today.

quiz.zh: 要不是路上堵车，我们早就到机场了。
quiz.en: If it weren't for the traffic, we'd have reached the airport long ago.

近日.gloss: recently; in the past few days

example.zh: 近日，本市多所中小学举办了科技节活动。
example.en: Several primary and secondary schools in the city recently held science festivals.

quiz.zh: 警方近日破获了一起特大网络诈骗案。
quiz.en: Police recently cracked a major online fraud case.

example.zh: 教室的墙上贴着孩子们画的图画。
example.en: The children's drawings are put up on the classroom wall.

quiz.zh: 这本书里有很多彩色图画，小朋友特别喜欢。
quiz.en: This book has lots of colour pictures, and kids love it.

example.zh: 冬天和朋友一起吃火锅，又热闹又暖和。
example.en: Eating hot pot with friends in winter is lively and warming.

quiz.zh: 重庆的火锅以麻辣出名，很多外地人都吃不惯。
quiz.en: Chongqing hot pot is famous for being numbing and spicy, and many outsiders can't handle it.

小于.gloss: to be less than; to be smaller than

example.zh: 这个房间的面积小于二十平方米，住两个人有点挤。
example.en: This room is under twenty square metres, a bit cramped for two people.

quiz.zh: 按照规定，重量小于五公斤的行李可以带上飞机。
quiz.en: Under the rules, luggage weighing less than five kilos can be taken on board.

example.zh: 学校的课外活动丰富多彩，学生们都很喜欢。
example.en: The school's extracurricular activities are rich and varied, and the students love them.

quiz.zh: 退休以后，爷爷的生活过得丰富多彩，一点也不无聊。
quiz.en: Since retiring, Grandpa has led a full and varied life and is never bored.

example.zh: 他的长处是做事认真，从来不马虎。
example.en: His strength is that he's conscientious and never careless.

quiz.zh: 我们应该多学习别人的长处，弥补自己的不足。
quiz.en: We should learn from others' strengths to make up for our own shortcomings.

升温.gloss: to heat up; to warm up; to intensify (fig.)

example.zh: 进入四月以后，各地开始快速升温。
example.en: Once April arrives, temperatures start to rise quickly everywhere.

quiz.zh: 随着比赛临近，两队之间的竞争不断升温。
quiz.en: As the match draws near, the rivalry between the two teams keeps heating up.

example.zh: 这门课一共两个学分，每周上两节。
example.en: This course is worth two credits, with two classes a week.

quiz.zh: 他还差四个学分才能毕业，只好再读一个学期。
quiz.en: He's still four credits short of graduating, so he has to study another term.

example.zh: 近年来，越来越多的年轻人选择回家乡创业。
example.en: In recent years, more and more young people have chosen to return home to start businesses.

quiz.zh: 近年来，中国的高铁发展非常迅速。
quiz.en: China's high-speed rail has developed very rapidly in recent years.

example.zh: 半夜里，楼上突然传来一阵很大的响声。
example.en: In the middle of the night, there was suddenly a loud noise from upstairs.

quiz.zh: 这扇门太旧了，一开就发出吱吱的响声。
quiz.en: This door is so old it creaks whenever you open it.

example.zh: 这几年物价涨得很快，工资却没怎么涨。
example.en: Prices have risen fast these past few years, but wages have barely moved.

quiz.zh: 这座城市物价比较低，很适合退休养老。
quiz.en: The cost of living in this city is fairly low, making it ideal for retirement.

example.zh: 他每天晚上开着台灯学习到很晚。
example.en: Every night he studies late with his desk lamp on.

quiz.zh: 书桌上的台灯坏了，屋里太暗，没法看书。
quiz.en: The lamp on the desk is broken, and the room is too dark to read in.

一路顺风.gloss: have a safe trip; bon voyage

example.zh: 你明天就要坐火车回老家了，祝你一路顺风！
example.en: You're taking the train home tomorrow, so have a safe trip!

quiz.zh: 送朋友上火车时，我们挥着手祝他一路顺风。
quiz.en: Seeing our friend off at the train, we waved and wished him a safe journey.

example.zh: 这张床的宽度是一米八，两个人睡也不挤。
example.en: This bed is 1.8 metres wide, so two people can sleep in it comfortably.

quiz.zh: 这条小路的宽度只能让一辆车通过。
quiz.en: This lane is only wide enough for one car to get through.

example.zh: 婚礼那天，亲朋好友都来祝贺他们。
example.en: On their wedding day, all their family and friends came to congratulate them.

quiz.zh: 他搬新家的时候，请了很多亲朋好友来家里吃饭。
quiz.en: When he moved into his new home, he invited lots of family and friends over for a meal.

example.zh: 这本词典的厚度差不多有十厘米。
example.en: This dictionary is almost ten centimetres thick.

quiz.zh: 湖面上的冰要达到一定的厚度，才能在上面滑冰。
quiz.en: The ice on the lake has to be thick enough before you can skate on it.

中医.gloss: traditional Chinese medicine; doctor of Chinese medicine

example.zh: 他的病西医治不好，后来找了一位老中医。
example.en: Western medicine couldn't cure his illness, so he went to an experienced doctor of Chinese medicine.

quiz.zh: 她一直在吃中医开的药，现在身体好多了。
quiz.en: She's been taking medicine prescribed by a Chinese medicine doctor and is much better now.

example.zh: 公司年初定下的目标，到年底已经全部完成了。
example.en: By the end of the year, the company had met all the targets it set at the start of the year.

quiz.zh: 他今年年初换了工作，现在收入比以前高多了。
quiz.en: He changed jobs at the start of this year and now earns much more than before.

example.zh: 飞机上的乘务员给乘客送来了饮料。
example.en: The flight attendants brought drinks to the passengers.

quiz.zh: 列车上的乘务员正在检查每位乘客的车票。
quiz.en: The train attendant is checking every passenger's ticket.

example.zh: 这款新手机的售价是五千九百九十九元。
example.en: This new phone retails at 5,999 yuan.

quiz.zh: 这种包的成本不到一百元，售价却高达两千元。
quiz.en: This bag costs less than a hundred yuan to make but sells for as much as two thousand.

example.zh: 为了环保，很多奶茶店开始使用纸吸管。
example.en: To help the environment, many bubble tea shops have started using paper straws.

quiz.zh: 小朋友用吸管喝果汁，一会儿就喝完了。
quiz.en: The little kid drank the juice through a straw and finished it in no time.

example.zh: 妈妈在客厅的窗台上摆了几盆花。
example.en: Mum has put a few pots of flowers on the living-room windowsill.

quiz.zh: 我家的猫最喜欢趴在窗台上晒太阳。
quiz.en: Our cat loves lying on the windowsill in the sun.

中外.gloss: China and foreign countries; Chinese and foreign

example.zh: 这次展览吸引了大批中外游客。
example.en: This exhibition attracted large numbers of Chinese and foreign visitors.

quiz.zh: 这部电影是中外合拍的，演员来自五个国家。
quiz.en: This film is a Chinese-foreign co-production, with actors from five countries.

example.zh: 新学年开始了，学生们都回到了学校。
example.en: The new school year has begun, and the students are all back at school.

quiz.zh: 在中国，一个学年通常分为上下两个学期。
quiz.en: In China, an academic year is usually divided into two semesters.

example.zh: 学了两年，他的汉语已经达到中级水平了。
example.en: After two years of study, his Chinese has reached an intermediate level.

quiz.zh: 她刚通过了中级会计师考试，下一步准备考高级。
quiz.en: She's just passed the intermediate accountant exam and is now preparing for the senior level.

首次.gloss: the first time; for the first time

example.zh: 这是中国队首次进入世界杯决赛。
example.en: This is the first time the Chinese team has reached the World Cup final.

quiz.zh: 这位歌手将于下个月首次来北京举办演唱会。
quiz.en: The singer will hold a concert in Beijing for the first time next month.

example.zh: 很多中国人早餐喜欢喝豆浆、吃油条。
example.en: Many Chinese people like soy milk and fried dough sticks for breakfast.

quiz.zh: 她每天早上自己磨豆浆，觉得比外面买的干净。
quiz.en: She makes her own soy milk every morning; she thinks it's cleaner than shop-bought.

example.zh: 每次出差回来，他都会给同事带一些当地特产。
example.en: Every time he comes back from a business trip, he brings his colleagues some local specialties.

quiz.zh: 哈密瓜是新疆的特产，又甜又脆。
quiz.en: Hami melons are a Xinjiang specialty; they're sweet and crisp.

example.zh: 这家超市提供免费配送服务，一个小时就能送到。
example.en: This supermarket offers free delivery and gets your order to you within an hour.

quiz.zh: 网上订的家具由商家负责配送和安装。
quiz.en: For furniture ordered online, the seller handles delivery and installation.

example.zh: 书法是中华传统文化的重要组成部分。
example.en: Calligraphy is an important part of traditional Chinese culture.

quiz.zh: 这家中华老字号已经有三百多年的历史了。
quiz.en: This time-honoured Chinese brand has a history of more than three hundred years.

example.zh: 中药虽然很苦，但对调理身体很有效。
example.en: Chinese herbal medicine tastes bitter, but it's very good for building up your health.

quiz.zh: 医生给他开了一个星期的中药，让他每天熬着喝。
quiz.en: The doctor prescribed him a week of herbal medicine to boil and drink every day.

example.zh: 中午工作太忙，大家就在办公室吃盒饭。
example.en: Work was so busy at noon that everyone ate boxed lunches in the office.

quiz.zh: 火车上卖的盒饭又贵又不好吃。
quiz.en: The boxed meals sold on the train are expensive and not very good.

example.zh: 爷爷退休后开始学画国画，最喜欢画山水。
example.en: Grandpa took up traditional Chinese painting after retiring; landscapes are his favourite.

quiz.zh: 这位画家的国画作品在国外也很受欢迎。
quiz.en: This artist's traditional Chinese paintings are very popular abroad as well.

example.zh: 买牛奶的时候，一定要看清保质期。
example.en: When you buy milk, always check the best-before date.

quiz.zh: 这包饼干已经过了保质期，千万别吃了。
quiz.en: This packet of biscuits is past its best-before date; don't eat it.

example.zh: 这个月打了很多长途，话费比平时高了不少。
example.en: I made a lot of long-distance calls this month, so my phone bill is much higher than usual.

quiz.zh: 手机欠费停机了，我得赶紧去交话费。
quiz.en: My phone's been cut off for non-payment; I need to pay the bill right away.

example.zh: 姥爷今年八十岁了，身体还很硬朗。
example.en: Grandpa is eighty this year and still in great shape.

quiz.zh: 放假的时候，我总爱去姥姥、姥爷家住几天。
quiz.en: During the holidays I always love staying a few days with my grandma and grandpa.

example.zh: 这家公司专门生产高科技产品。
example.en: This company specialises in making high-tech products.

quiz.zh: 现在种地也用上了高科技，用无人机就能给庄稼打药。
quiz.en: Farming now uses high technology too; drones can spray the crops.

example.zh: 这个字有两个读音，意思也不一样。
example.en: This character has two pronunciations with different meanings.

quiz.zh: 遇到不认识的字，可以查字典确认它的读音。
quiz.en: When you come across a character you don't know, you can check its pronunciation in a dictionary.

example.zh: 春天到了，花园里开满了五颜六色的花。
example.en: Spring has come, and the garden is full of flowers of every colour.

quiz.zh: 节日的晚上，天空中绽放着五颜六色的烟花。
quiz.en: On the night of the festival, fireworks of every colour burst across the sky.

example.zh: 到了台湾，一定要去逛逛夜市。
example.en: When you go to Taiwan, you must visit a night market.

quiz.zh: 晚上八点以后，夜市上人来人往，特别热闹。
quiz.en: After eight in the evening, the night market is bustling with people.

example.zh: 这个词的用法比较复杂，老师讲了好几遍。
example.en: The usage of this word is quite complicated; the teacher explained it several times.

quiz.zh: 吃药之前，一定要仔细阅读说明书上的用法和用量。
quiz.en: Before taking the medicine, be sure to read the directions and dosage on the leaflet carefully.

example.zh: 南方人的主食是米饭，北方人更爱吃面食。
example.en: Southerners' staple food is rice, while northerners prefer wheat-based foods.

quiz.zh: 减肥不等于不吃主食，关键是要控制好量。
quiz.en: Losing weight doesn't mean giving up staple foods; the key is controlling portions.

跳高.gloss: high jump; to do the high jump

example.zh: 他在运动会上参加了跳高比赛，得了第一名。
example.en: He entered the high jump at the sports meet and came first.

quiz.zh: 他个子高，弹跳又好，教练让他专门练跳高。
quiz.en: He's tall and a great jumper, so the coach had him specialise in the high jump.

example.zh: 新房装修好以后，他们买了全套家电。
example.en: Once the new flat was renovated, they bought a full set of home appliances.

quiz.zh: 国家出台了家电以旧换新的补贴政策。
quiz.en: The government has introduced subsidies for trading in old household appliances for new ones.

example.zh: 他第一次吃西餐，不太会用刀叉。
example.en: It was his first time eating Western food, and he wasn't very good with a knife and fork.

quiz.zh: 他吃不惯西餐，总觉得牛排没有中国菜香。
quiz.en: He can't get used to Western food; he always feels steak isn't as tasty as Chinese dishes.

example.zh: 他从不在别人面前说朋友的短处。
example.en: He never talks about his friends' faults in front of others.

quiz.zh: 他知道自己的短处是不善于表达，所以一直在努力改进。
quiz.en: He knows his weakness is that he's not good at expressing himself, so he keeps working on it.

酸甜苦辣.gloss: all the flavors of life; life's joys and sorrows
酸甜苦辣.indonesian: suka duka kehidupan; pahit manis kehidupan

example.zh: 人生总有酸甜苦辣，经历多了就看开了。
example.en: Life always has its ups and downs; once you've been through enough, you learn to take them in stride.

quiz.zh: 这本书写的是一位老人一生的酸甜苦辣。
quiz.en: This book tells of the joys and sorrows of an old man's life.

example.zh: 奥运会闭幕式上，运动员们依依不舍地告别。
example.en: At the Olympic closing ceremony, the athletes said their reluctant goodbyes.

quiz.zh: 比赛最后一天的晚上将举行隆重的闭幕式。
quiz.en: A grand closing ceremony will be held on the evening of the last day of the games.

example.zh: 爷爷每天早上都要用毛笔练一个小时的字。
example.en: Every morning Grandpa spends an hour practising calligraphy with a brush.

quiz.zh: 学书法要先学会正确地握毛笔。
quiz.en: When learning calligraphy, you first have to learn to hold the brush properly.

跳远.gloss: long jump; to do the long jump

example.zh: 她在学校运动会上跳远跳出了五米多的好成绩。
example.en: At the school sports meet she achieved a great result of over five metres in the long jump.

quiz.zh: 他助跑后用力一跳，跳远成绩达到了七米。
quiz.en: After a run-up he leapt with all his strength, reaching seven metres in the long jump.

没法儿.gloss: can't; there's no way (to do something)

example.zh: 雨下得这么大，我们今天没法儿出去了。
example.en: It's raining so hard there's no way we can go out today.

quiz.zh: 他说话声音太小，我根本没法儿听清楚。
quiz.en: He speaks so quietly that I just can't hear him clearly.

example.zh: 这本书有电子版，可以在手机上看。
example.en: This book has an e-version you can read on your phone.

quiz.zh: 请把合同的电子版发到我的邮箱。
quiz.en: Please send the electronic copy of the contract to my email.

example.zh: 楼下的便利店二十四小时营业，买东西很方便。
example.en: The convenience store downstairs is open 24 hours, so shopping is easy.

quiz.zh: 加班到半夜，他只能去便利店买点吃的。
quiz.en: After working overtime until midnight, all he could do was grab something to eat at a convenience store.

example.zh: 现在买东西扫一下二维码就能付钱。
example.en: These days you can pay for things just by scanning a QR code.

quiz.zh: 请扫描屏幕上的二维码，关注我们的公众号。
quiz.en: Please scan the QR code on the screen to follow our official account.

example.zh: 上车以后，请大家系好安全带。
example.en: Once you're in the car, everyone please fasten your seatbelts.

quiz.zh: 飞机遇到气流颠簸时，乘客一定要系紧安全带。
quiz.en: When the plane hits turbulence, passengers must keep their seatbelts tightly fastened.

不符.gloss: not in accordance with; not to match

example.zh: 网上的照片和实物完全不符，我要退货。
example.en: The item looks nothing like the photo online; I want to return it.

quiz.zh: 他的说法与事实不符，警方决定继续调查。
quiz.en: His account doesn't match the facts, so the police have decided to investigate further.

example.zh: 橙子富含维生素C，多吃对身体有好处。
example.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C, and eating more of them is good for you.

quiz.zh: 她把橙子切成四块，放在盘子里给客人吃。
quiz.en: She cut the orange into quarters and put them on a plate for the guests.

example.zh: 公园的池子里养着很多金鱼。
example.en: There are lots of goldfish in the pond in the park.

quiz.zh: 池里的荷花开了，引来不少人拍照。
quiz.en: The lotus flowers in the pond are in bloom, drawing plenty of people to take photos.

充值.gloss: to top up; to recharge (an account or card)

example.zh: 这张公交卡里没钱了，得去充值。
example.en: There's no money left on this bus card; I need to top it up.

quiz.zh: 他偷偷在游戏里充值了几千块钱，被父母狠狠骂了一顿。
quiz.en: He secretly spent several thousand yuan topping up his game account and got a real telling-off from his parents.

点赞.gloss: to like (a post); to give a thumbs-up, to praise

example.zh: 她刚发了一条朋友圈，很快就有几十个人点赞。
example.en: She'd only just posted on WeChat Moments when dozens of people liked it.

quiz.zh: 大家纷纷为这位见义勇为的小伙子点赞。
quiz.en: People everywhere gave a thumbs-up to the young man who bravely stepped in to help.

example.zh: 电商的发展让人们足不出户就能买到东西。
example.en: The growth of e-commerce lets people buy things without leaving home.

quiz.zh: 每年双十一，各大电商平台都会推出大量优惠。
quiz.en: Every year on Singles' Day, all the major e-commerce platforms roll out huge deals.

example.zh: 他的汉语发音非常标准，听起来像中国人。
example.en: His Chinese pronunciation is very standard; he sounds like a native speaker.

quiz.zh: 这个词你发音不对，再跟我读一遍。
quiz.en: You're not pronouncing this word right; say it after me again.

example.zh: 非洲有很多野生动物，比如狮子和大象。
example.en: Africa has lots of wild animals, such as lions and elephants.

quiz.zh: 他毕业后去非洲做了两年志愿者。
quiz.en: After graduating, he spent two years volunteering in Africa.

example.zh: 今天太晚了，我们改天再聊吧。
example.en: It's too late today; let's talk another day.

quiz.zh: 这家店今天没开门，我们改天再来吧。
quiz.en: The shop isn't open today; let's come back another day.

各行各业.gloss: all trades and professions; every walk of life

example.zh: 来自各行各业的人都参加了这次志愿活动。
example.en: People from all walks of life took part in this volunteer event.

quiz.zh: 互联网已经深入到各行各业，改变了人们的工作方式。
quiz.en: The internet has reached into every industry and changed the way people work.

贵姓.gloss: (polite) your surname; may I ask your name

example.zh: 初次见面，请问您贵姓？我姓王。
example.en: Nice to meet you. May I ask your surname? Mine is Wang.

quiz.zh: 先生，请问您贵姓？我帮您登记一下。
quiz.en: Sir, may I have your surname? I'll register you.

降水.gloss: precipitation; to have rain or snow

example.zh: 这个地区全年降水很少，气候非常干燥。
example.en: This region gets very little precipitation all year, and the climate is very dry.

quiz.zh: 气象台预计，未来三天全省大部分地区将出现明显降水。
quiz.en: The weather service forecasts significant rain or snow across most of the province over the next three days.

example.zh: 这家超市卖很多进口食品，价格比较贵。
example.en: This supermarket sells lots of imported food, which is fairly expensive.

quiz.zh: 中国每年都要从国外进口大量石油。
quiz.en: China imports large amounts of oil from abroad every year.

久远.gloss: far back in time; ancient; remote

example.zh: 这座古城历史久远，留下了很多文物。
example.en: This ancient city has a long history and many surviving relics.

quiz.zh: 年代太久远了，墙上的字已经看不清了。
quiz.en: It's so old that the writing on the wall can no longer be made out.

example.zh: 收到的商品有问题，我马上联系了客服。
example.en: The item I received was faulty, so I contacted customer service right away.

quiz.zh: 我打了好几次客服电话，一直都占线。
quiz.en: I called the customer service line several times, but it was always busy.

example.zh: 他把手机放进了外套口袋里。
example.en: He put his phone in his coat pocket.

quiz.zh: 出门前，他摸了摸口袋，发现钥匙不见了。
quiz.en: Before going out, he felt his pocket and found his keys were gone.

example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜很合我的口味。
example.en: The food at this restaurant really suits my taste.

quiz.zh: 这种饮料有草莓、芒果等好几种口味。
quiz.en: This drink comes in several flavours, including strawberry and mango.

example.zh: 他的钱包被偷了，赶紧去派出所报了案。
example.en: His wallet was stolen, so he hurried to the police station to report it.

quiz.zh: 办身份证要去户口所在地的派出所。
quiz.en: To get an ID card, you have to go to the police station where your household is registered.

轻重.gloss: weight; importance, seriousness; sense of propriety

example.zh: 做事要分清轻重，先把最要紧的事办完。
example.en: You need to know what matters most and get the most urgent things done first.

quiz.zh: 这孩子说话不知轻重，常常得罪人。
quiz.en: This kid has no sense of what's appropriate to say and often offends people.

example.zh: 良好的人际关系对工作很有帮助。
example.en: Good relationships with people are very helpful at work.

quiz.zh: 她性格内向，不太擅长人际交往。
quiz.en: She's introverted and not very good at socialising.

example.zh: 中国是世界上人口最多的国家之一。
example.en: China is one of the most populous countries in the world.

quiz.zh: 这个小镇的人口不到一万，大家互相都认识。
quiz.en: This small town has a population of under ten thousand, and everyone knows each other.

example.zh: 有些商家为了赚钱，不惜卖假货。
example.en: Some merchants will even sell fake goods to make money.

quiz.zh: 顾客收到的商品有质量问题，商家应该负责退换。
quiz.en: If customers receive defective goods, the seller should be responsible for returns and exchanges.

example.zh: 他把旅行的照片上传到了网上。
example.en: He uploaded his travel photos online.

quiz.zh: 文件太大了，上传了半个小时还没完成。
quiz.en: The file is so big that it's been uploading for half an hour and still isn't done.

example.zh: 他很喜欢旅游，已经去过中国的大部分省份。
example.en: He loves travelling and has already been to most of China's provinces.

quiz.zh: 四川是中国人口较多的省份之一。
quiz.en: Sichuan is one of the more populous provinces in China.

example.zh: 吃完饭，服务员又送来了一份甜品。
example.en: After the meal, the waiter brought out a dessert.

quiz.zh: 她特别爱吃甜品，蛋糕、冰淇淋都离不了。
quiz.en: She has a real sweet tooth and can't live without cake and ice cream.

example.zh: 如果对商品不满意，七天内可以退还全部货款。
example.en: If you're not satisfied with the product, you can get a full refund within seven days.

quiz.zh: 房子退租时，房东把押金全部退还给了我。
quiz.en: When I moved out, the landlord returned my entire deposit.

example.zh: 奶奶拿出一本旧相册，给我们看她年轻时的照片。
example.en: Grandma took out an old photo album and showed us pictures of herself when she was young.

quiz.zh: 他的手机相册里存了上万张照片。
quiz.en: He has tens of thousands of pictures saved in his phone's photo album.

example.zh: 天太热了，我们去买根雪糕吃吧。
example.en: It's so hot; let's go and buy an ice cream.

quiz.zh: 孩子一口气吃了三根雪糕，结果肚子疼了。
quiz.en: The kid ate three ice lollies in a row and ended up with a stomach ache.

邮寄.gloss: to send by mail; to post

example.zh: 我把生日礼物邮寄给了在国外的朋友。
example.en: I mailed the birthday present to my friend abroad.

quiz.zh: 录取通知书会通过快递邮寄到学生家里。
quiz.en: Admission letters will be sent to students' homes by courier.

example.zh: 油条刚出锅的时候最好吃，又香又脆。
example.en: Fried dough sticks are best fresh out of the wok, fragrant and crispy.

quiz.zh: 这家早餐店的油条特别有名，每天早上都排长队。
